messages.麻痺と守備威力減少で敵の守備スキルと攻撃を崩す打撃デバッファー。ほかの打撃人格と: A Blunt debuffer that breaks down enemy Defense skills and attacks with Paralyze and Defense Power Down. Her core strength is lining up with other Blunt Identities to strengthen S1 and S2, and, against enemies with clashable Defense skills or counters, Clashing with their attack skills to land S2 and S3 and help allies' Clashes.
messages.連続打撃で強化: S1「打撃」・S2「刺す」は、操作パネルの次のスキルが打撃スキ: **Bonuses from consecutive Blunt hits**: S1 Bludgeon and S2 Thrust gain +2 Coin Power if the next skill on the dashboard is a Blunt skill (Uptie Ⅳ). Because it references the next skill, it does not trigger if she is last in line or there are no other Blunt Identities.
messages.守備威力減少: S2はⅡコインの的中時に守備威力減少2/4、S3「制圧」はⅠコイ: **Defense Power Down**: S2 inflicts 2/4 Defense Power Down on Coin Ⅱ hit, and S3 Suppress inflicts 4 on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit. For 1 turn, it lowers the Final Power of Defense skills.
messages.麻痺: S1は表面的中時に麻痺1/3、S3はⅡコインの表面的中時に麻痺3。S3は: **Paralyze**: S1 inflicts 1/3 Paralyze on Heads Hit, and S3 inflicts 3 Paralyze on Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit. S3 also inflicts 4 Defense Level Down on Coin Ⅰ hit.
messages.S3の先制強化: 対象がこのターンにまだ攻撃でダメージを受けていなければコイン威: **S3's first-strike bonus**: +2/3 Coin Power if the target has not yet taken damage from an attack this turn.
messages.パッシブ: バトル「防御崩し」(嫉妬×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得)は、このターンに: **Passives**: The combat passive Breach Defense (3 Envy Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +10% damage against enemies that used a Defense skill this turn. The support passive Breaching (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +20% damage under the same condition to the 1 ally with the highest HP.
messages.S1・S2の強化には後ろに打撃スキルが続く必要があるので、同じくらいの速度の打撃: Strengthening S1 and S2 requires a Blunt skill to follow, so field her with Blunt Identities of similar Speed (to use her properly, take her to Uptie Ⅳ and pair her with Blunt Identities in the same Speed range). Defense Power Down mainly matters against enemies with clashable Defense skills or counters: Clash those enemies' attack skills with S2 and S3 to land them, making it easier for following allies to break their defenses. Clashable Defense skills are triggered by the first one-sided attack they receive, so trying to push through with one-sided attacks hits the defense before it is weakened. S3's bonus requires landing before anyone else, which is hard in today's Focused Encounters with many fast Identities, so it mainly pays off in regular battles.
